title: Donkey Kong Country x Touhou Koumakyou ~ the Embodiment of the Scarlet Devil - Roses 'N Kruelty 🌹 ~ Gang-Plank Galleon x U.N. Owen was Her? (Remix)
description:
❝ Right, I've had enough of this. It's time for me to get going. So you Kongs better get off of my ship or else! ❞
ㅤ- King K. Rool, Donkey Kong Country [GBA] (2003)


Did a mashup arrangement of King KAROOL's theme song Gang-Plank Galleon x Flandre Skarlet's theme song U.N. Owen Was Her? from Donkey Kong Country & Touhou 6 Koumakyou ~ the Embodiment of the Skarlet Devil, respektively. Two krazies, two bangers, one psykhotic mix!! This was a mix I planned for at the beginning of the year and, of kourse, expekted it to be one of my more ambitious ones.

Given this mashup's entire premise, I primarily wanted to primarily base this remix off the Smash Ultimate version of K. Rool's theme (given the pace of that version matches up with Flan's theme) while also retaining elements of the original.

Important:
ㅤ♠ "Bonus End," P-Switch, Yoshi SFX, & Thunder SFX are disabled.
ㅤ♠ Death sound is gonna sound weird (@0 replaces @9 to save on space).

There are also kustomizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. D Minor (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. C Minor (Pseudo Paradise Pitch)
ㅤ3. E Minor (Gouyoku Ibun Pitch)

There are also kustomizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Original Echo Delay, but sacrifices SMW-Compatibility (OG Echo)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. Dekreased Echo Delay, but removes the intro (DISABLES Intro)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. DRASTICALLY Dekreased Echo Delay (LOWER Echo)
